recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring two male figures suspended in mid-air against a solid lavender-purple backdrop. The figures are captured in dynamic, falling poses with a gritty, film-grain texture and vertical motion-smear effects trailing from their limbs. The overall aesthetic combines clean studio photography with raw, distressed graphic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the two floating figures
Contrast between the flat purple background and the textured subjects
Vertical motion trails anchoring the subjects to the canvas
Balance between handwritten script and heavy block lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the central and upper-right quadrants; the primary figure is scaled larger and positioned diagonally across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large figure's dark boots and the heavy block text in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the central figure from top-left to bottom-right, then moves to the secondary figure in the upper-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the figures emphasizes the sensation of falling or floating in a void.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lavender purple (#A682E6) as the primary background field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark navy in the clothing and motion trails.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white in the undershirt and socks to create focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation background against low-value, high-contrast subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to purple, black, white, and muted skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of loose gestural script and ultra-bold condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thin, rapid strokes with connected loops and varying baseline.
Block: Vertical elongation, zero kerning, and heavy distressing/erosion on edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the block text are fused together to create a singular graphic mass.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, thin handwriting and industrial, heavy block type.

preserve: The vertical stacking of the block text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight for the block text base.
Matches the gestural quality of the top-left text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid lavender-purple background with a heavy film grain texture. Place two men in urban clothing (jackets, trousers, boots) in mid-air falling poses. Apply vertical black charcoal-like motion blur trails extending from their limbs.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy, distressed, ultra-condensed black block-letter title in the bottom-left corner. Add a thin, black, gestural handwritten script in the top-left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent lavender purple?
Do the figures have vertical motion trails?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the bottom-left text heavily condensed and distressed?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the motion trails are strictly vertical.
Check that the purple background doesn't have distracting patterns.
Verify the block text looks stamped or eroded.
Confirm the figures appear to be in the same 3D space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Lavender background + floating high-contrast subjects + vertical charcoal trails + distressed condensed typography.
